aliases: Final Pinned Memory and CUDA Streams
Pinned Memory and CUDA Streams Optimization
VolRec Pinned Memory and CUDA Streams Optimization
definition: An optimization technique using CUDA streams and pinned memory to overlap device-to-host and host-to-device data copies with GPU kernel computation, maximizing throughput.
summary: This optimization overlaps GPU computation with data transfers using CUDA streams and page-locked memory to eliminate synchronization stalls and maximize throughput.
